aliasRemark.remarks: Aliases accumulate: calling this twice adds both rather than replacing the first.

addInputRemark.remarks: Only for inputs no pipeline asks for. A command normally harvests its options from the InputSpec of each pipeline it runs, so a stage that binds --configuration is what puts --configuration in --help; registering the same option here as well would duplicate it.

pipelineDefault.remarks: A default, not an override: it applies to every pipeline the command runs, but only where that pipeline left the setting alone. A pipeline that sets the same thing for itself keeps its own value, whichever order the two were written in.
